deploy-bot: [release] Tag `v2.8.0-rc3` created for repo `redwood/runtime` on branch `main` (commit `9f8b3d1`). Changelog summary:
- perf: improved KV cache hit for long-context workloads
- fix: model routing fallback when GPU pool is full
- infra: added metrics for batcher queue length
Full changelog: https://git.redwood.dev/redwood/runtime/compare/rc2...rc3
Environment: staging. Scheduled canary -> prod rollout pending (start in ~30m).

Sam (release engineer): Reviewing notes now. Any DB migrations or schema changes?
Ava (eng-rel): No migrations — runtime-only. I'll pin `redwood-api` to `v2.8.0-rc3` for the smoke window on staging.
Kai (oncall): Can we delay the prod rollout 15m? We're seeing noisy infra alerts from the batcher stack.
Ava (eng-rel): Ok delaying by 15m. @deploy-bot please hold the rollout until 1771124396.
deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Rollout schedule updated — canary start set to 1771124396.
Lina (QA): Quick checklist for canary: smoke tests, latency regression <5%, healthchecks green. I'll run them at canary start.
Sam (release engineer): Canary plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% at ~10m intervals if metrics are good. Manual rollback plan: revert commit `9f8b3d1` and redeploy `v2.8.0-rc2` if needed.
Ava (eng-rel): Ops pinning note: update k8s deployment annotation `release-tag: v2.8.0-rc3` and notify #infra when prod finishes.
Kai (oncall): Abort criteria: batcher queue > 75th percentile for >3m OR error rate spike >2x baseline during canary -> immediate rollback.
Sam (release engineer): I'll draft the short release blurb for #announcements once prod completes. :party_parrot:
Ava (eng-rel): Thanks — tagging this thread for visibility. Ping me directly if something fails during canary.
